title: Revolutions in Understanding Mind and Brain
coreMove: Use medication to lower unbearable symptoms, then ask how helplessness was learned and where choice can be rebuilt; calmer chemistry is not the same as restored agency.

exampleSpecs.stakes: prevent diagnosis from erasing the patient's biography
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: keep medication useful while asking what happened

exampleSpecs.stakes: keep passivity from being misread as refusal
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: show that available escape may not feel usable

exampleSpecs.stakes: avoid treating symptom reduction as full recovery
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: use medication as relief, not as the whole map

exampleSpecs.stakes: learn from control measures without making control the whole story
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: ask what the chart did not hear

exampleSpecs.stakes: turn a failed-help pattern into a usable choice
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: create small proof that action changes outcome

exampleSpecs.stakes: replace blame with a plan for felt safety
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: explain repetition without calling it preference
